conditionalRelease.rule: Prepare and publish the accepted 3.2 candidate under this bound user direction. Commit and push the complete in-scope candidate before publication; bind hosted checks and the new release to the same immutable SHA and exclude unrelated dirty work. This intent is not present readiness. Resolve a materially new cost, trust, data or destructive effect before it occurs; do not rewrite prior releases or repeatedly ask the user to reconfirm this same direction.

authority.rule: This records the bound user decision; it cannot manufacture authority for another goal or effect. Later corrections can revise the development design.

This successor governs the approved development scope, not the installed v3.1.0 package. In that scope its definitions replace conflicting historical prescriptions, including the mandatory event-to-pure-core path and runtime escalation ladder. Compatible historical responsibilities remain covered, not silently removed.

cycle.scopeRule: Preserve necessary outcomes; review each inherited function and mechanism for actual need. Delegate to suitable host capabilities; compare maintained alternatives for a material gap or plausible net benefit, not only native failure. Merge or retire unnecessary assets with callers and acceptance reconciled. Keep existing Codex/Claude scope before expanding hosts. Development is not candidate acceptance or publication; review compatibility before final version selection.
cycle.sourceDecision: The approved source semantics are carried forward in this open development successor. A development commit records code identity, not an accepted source-phase closeout or release receipt.

source.purpose: Drive the host and Agent to fulfill responsibilities needed for an authorized outcome. Reuse available host resources and maintained alternatives; compose or build when justified by required effects and total lifecycle burden. Own supported mechanics across functions, settings, configuration, interaction, resources, context, handoff and lifecycle. Human decision authority is distinct from manual operation; preserve intervention and revocation. Visible controls are not automatically actionable or authorized. No unmeasured majority-of-controls claim is made. Reduce avoidable user orchestration, correction and recovery; owning every implementation is not the product goal. Machine-suited representations, parallelism and automation may serve human goals without imitating human work routines. Judge them by observable effect, relevant lookup and adaptation cost, evidence, inspectability and necessary human control, not assumed machine superiority.
source.hypothesis: Context-selected intervention can improve bounded outcomes and total collaboration burden. A correct design, isolated success or safe stop alone does not establish that incremental value.
source.bootstrapBoundary: Bootstrap through an available, authorized host entry and observable conditions. Reuse supported discovery, execution, state and recovery; Accord intervention need not supply a duplicate executor or runtime. Add only justified missing means or material improvement. Injection or self-bootstrapping creates neither authority, hidden-state access, physical feasibility nor a surviving recovery actor after all components fail. Retire redundant assets after checking callers, still-needed effects and affected acceptance; historical receipts keep their original scope.

globalInvariants.meaning: Respect applicable obligations and safety boundaries, human-owned authority, privacy and ownership, and truthful evidence and claims. No route, policy change or success definition may waive these boundaries.

source.boundCommitment: The authorized goal, required functions, quality, accepted risk and result criteria are binding within their named task and revision. They are not permanent global constants, but the Agent cannot silently relax them to fit an available mechanism. A legitimate change revises the bound commitment explicitly and invalidates affected acceptance.

successStates.responsibilities-accounted: Every required responsibility has an explicit disposition and support or an honest gap; this is accounting, not functional success.
successStates.function-verified: A named function achieves its required observable effect through an available normal entry in an exact supported composition, including relevant failure and lifecycle conditions.
successStates.outcome-complete: Every necessary bound result and applicable post-state condition is sufficiently verified; unknown or failed necessary results prevent completion.
successStates.safely-stopped: Further effects are safely bounded while the missing result, authority or feasibility is disclosed; safe stopping does not fulfill an unmet functional commitment.
successStates.value-supported: Suitable evidence supports the claimed improvement after accounting for total intervention, evaluator, user, recovery and lifecycle cost; comparative claims require a valid comparison.

classes.compliance: Global boundary; context determines which concrete obligations apply, not whether compliance can be waived.
classes.commitment: Applies to the explicitly bound goal, scope and revision until legitimately changed.
classes.strategy: Applies only when its conditions are supported in the current task; it may be composed, replaced or retired.

applicability.unknown: Resolve only decision-relevant uncertainty. Hold the dependent consequential action when necessary; an unknown field does not automatically block unrelated safe work or shrink the promised functionality.
applicability.conflict: Preserve compliance, reconcile the latest legitimate bound commitment, then compare applicable strategies. A local success, failure or host label cannot activate a rule globally.
applicability.representation: These are semantic responsibilities, not mandatory per-message records or a fixed workflow. Reuse supported host state; materialize only the information needed for the current decision.

implementation.runtimeRequirement: 不预设必须依赖独立运行时，也不预设无运行时足够。按所需可靠性绑定触发者、实际执行者、必要状态载体和故障后的接管者，再判断宿主原生机制、Hook、脚本、Skill 或其它对象的组合是否兑现；一轮任务可只需宿主现有 Agent 循环和上下文。对确定触发、强制约束、跨轮状态、无人值守推进或故障后继续执行，核验实际职责与效果，而非用对象名称代替判断。仅在现有组合确有执行、状态或恢复缺口时补足相应机制，包括有依据的持久运行时。Skill 是可解释指导，不是独立调度器或强制执行保证；历史良好体验也不能单独归因于运行时。任何组合仍须验收普通入口、失败及独立后态。
implementation.rule: Compare native, maintained, composed and authored means on evidenced functional and quality sufficiency, context fit and total lifecycle burden. Native means are a low-burden starting point or equivalent-fit preference, not a veto on superior external means. A runtime is eligible when its execution, state or recovery properties fit the need; no form must be built and fail first. Reuse sufficient host discovery and execution rather than duplicate them.

modelSelection.trigger: A task or bounded subtask needs a model/effort choice, or relevant requirements, capabilities, permissions, quotas or effects change. Do not rematch every turn without a material reason.
modelSelection.selection: Within currently authorized and available candidates, match task difficulty, risk, modalities, tools, context, latency, cost and quality floors. Seek best supported fit, not an unverifiable global optimum or a fixed brand ranking.
modelSelection.authority: Honor explicit user model/effort selections and restrictions. Selection does not authorize a new provider, data transfer, account or material cost. Do not invent unsupported parent-model hot switching or delegation.
modelSelection.nativeReplacement: Reuse native task/subagent model parameters, defaults, inheritance and supported routing when sufficient. Remove duplicate Accord selection/dispatch implementation only when the same required matching, execution and adaptation are closed; retain accountability for an unmet need.
modelSelection.verification: Bind task need, allowed candidate facts, chosen route and actual host-reported execution model/effort when exposed. Reconcile provider aliases, inherited or substituted models, quality and total lifecycle cost. A request parameter, listing or name is not proof of backend identity or optimality; hold unavailable facts unknown.
modelSelection.failureOracle: Reject unsupported automatic-switch claims, silent replacement of a pinned model, quality loss disguised as cost savings, default inheritance mistaken for task matching, unobserved subagent execution, or duplicated native routing without a demonstrated gap.

implementation.triggerRule: A user request, supported lifecycle signal, relevant state change or just-in-time decision may trigger the chain. Eventless hosts can re-sense at material boundaries. No Hook or pure-core invocation is universally required.
implementation.nativeRule: Native or composed implementation counts when it fulfills the same duty; no Accord-owned code is required. Availability is not observed execution. Leave a sufficient low-burden route alone when no decision-relevant improvement warrants comparison; native sufficiency alone does not close discovery or prove incremental Accord value. Count current model reasoning, decomposition, selection, correction and delegation as well as host interfaces. Reassess after material change and retire intervention that no longer earns its cost, preserving still-needed effects.
implementation.reconstructionRule: Review the entire required chain before local optimization: need and trigger, current facts and selection, execution and state, failure ownership, result verification and attributable cleanup. Skill, Hook, pure core, runtime, their quantity and connections may be retained, split, merged, replaced or removed. Choose each change by end-to-end sufficiency and total burden, not inherited packaging or a minimum-file target. Replace a broken premise or chain from its earliest affected dependency boundary, including full redesign where justified; reconcile affected design, package admission, procedures and acceptance while preserving unrelated user state and historical evidence. Indexes and graphs are optional representations, not required outcomes or proof of closure. Compare actual callers, decision quality and query speed against construction, refresh, staleness, resource and maintenance cost. Use direct queries or sufficient host means when appropriate; derive a view only when it earns its cost. Retire a redundant representation without losing necessary relationships or effects.

supportingPrinciples.precondition: Safety, compliance and the full bound functional and quality commitment constrain these strategies. They optimize how the commitment is fulfilled; they cannot silently reduce it.
supportingPrinciples.subtraction: Remove duplication, ineffective work or displaced mechanisms only while preserving required effects, user experience and applicable failure coverage. Smaller code, fewer dependencies or less persistent state are not improvements if necessary orchestration or recovery work returns to the user.
supportingPrinciples.restraint: Avoid unnecessary intervention and complexity; invest in sufficient mechanisms, including a runtime, when required by the result.
supportingPrinciples.fallback: Contain failure and preserve a safe state, then own the feasible authorized recovery path. If the result remains unmet, disclose the gap; a safe stop is not functional completion.
supportingPrinciples.gapFilling: Supply or compose the exact capability or coordination missing from the current environment, then reassess its need when native conditions change.
supportingPrinciples.activation: Select the relevant strategy by the present duty, observed gap and failure consequences. No strategy must run on every task, and none is a product-wide prohibition on implementation.

capabilityMap.representation: One versioned semantic source owns outcomes and evidence requirements; workSequence owns procedures and exits. Duty ids join the review views without a second authority. Indexes, graphs, matrices and caches are replaceable representations justified by actual consumers and decision or maintenance benefit, not required product modules. Direct task-time queries may suffice. dependsOn is implementation-order review, not a live feedback or execution graph. This dated inventory is not every vendor or host/model/tool combination; model, host and composed capability remain distinct.
capabilityMap.refreshRule: At a relevant decision, inspect the running client, actual provider/model, policy and exposed interface. Version/feature/configuration/package/permission changes, a supported invalidation event, source contradiction, missing observation or failed effect reopen affected applicability. Re-read supported state and only the needed official documentation; no automatic network watcher or fixed global expiry is installed. Retain the dated observation as history, never as permanently current support.
capabilityMap.allocationRule: Allocate by bound effects, evidence, fit and full adoption/use/recovery/exit cost. Reuse host discovery and lifecycle; compare beyond installed tools for a material gap or plausible net benefit. Native preference resolves comparable fit, not a better external candidate. Retire verified duplicates; a necessary duty survives implementation retirement, while an unnecessary duty needs revised need and acceptance. Symbiosis is a goal, not value evidence.
capabilityMap.runtimeGap: The current host Skill supplies adaptive guidance, not a proven system executor. Historical dev.2 native repair and same-session resume observations do not qualify this candidate, incremental value, surviving failure ownership, zero-history handoff or package lifecycle. closure.py remains a no-I/O reference core: callers supply candidates and comparison facts; it does not discover tools or establish their truth. Keeping that reference outside the ordinary entry is not itself a defect. The uncalled simulated graph demonstration has been retired from the current tree; its historical paths resolve at their original revisions. Needed discovery, decisions and effects still require sufficient observable host or composed execution.

- codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs resolve_resume_thread_id accepts a parsable UUID directly. Otherwise it searches by title; an unresolved title yields None. The caller's None branch starts a new thread. For this ID-only example, a conservative UUID input check can avoid the name/option path; missing/invalid inputs should fail before SDK actuation. Compute conditional admission by exact source/package/oracle identity, applicable coverage and final freshness, not stored assessments or diagnostics. Changes to requiredCoverage or applicable definitions invalidate dependent evidence. Static claimCeiling, empty cases and undeclared or unresolved requirements cannot grant qualification. Human authority, hosted checks and publication remain separate.

acceptance.coverageRule: The inherited responsibilities below are a review inventory, not an immutable feature list. Review necessity against the user's actual goal: retain, delegate to the host, merge, retire or fill a demonstrated gap. Record retired/merged responsibilities and their changed acceptance explicitly rather than silently dropping coverage. Preserve the outcomes that remain necessary, not every historical implementation or test. Decomposition and test identifiers are revisable mappings. Actively discover unlisted design defects, broken cross-function relations, entry/configuration blind spots and unnecessary mechanisms through task-relevant official changes, realistic normal-entry work, counterexamples and failure observations. Known findings seed but never bound the review. Prioritize consequences and affected dependencies; end a research branch when sufficient evidence supports the next safe implementation or validation. Complete outcomes and independently observed value, not counts of documents, tests, rules or components, determine completeness.
acceptance.functionReview: For each applicable result establish the user need, current sufficient host responsibility, necessary Accord intervention, observable effect and lifecycle cost. Judge native sufficiency against prebound outcomes, quality, authority and applicable post-state in the actual entry and composition; use risk-scaled effect/failure evidence and acceptable total burden, not capability names or one lucky success. Simple reversible work can execute and verify directly. Unknowns limit dependent claims; sufficiency is contextual and is not optimality or product retirement. The inventory requires neither one module per duty nor one stage per action. Separate task delivery and verification from optional cross-task learning, authorized package lifecycle and maintainer product/value qualification. If a need no longer applies, revise its dependent acceptance explicitly; if only its representation or implementation is redundant, preserve the result through a verified replacement. Machine-suited means need no human-workflow imitation, but still need evidence and necessary human control.
acceptance.executionBoundary: Bind the responsible executor and necessary state to the exact normal entry and failure window. Native or composed execution can fulfill a duty without Accord-owned code. Evaluate continuity, recovery and attributable resource release across the same transition; an implementation-order DAG or isolated passes cannot prove that chain. Before installation or after removal, lifecycle and compensation must remain available independently of the absent Skill. Evaluator-only execution proves its experimental composition, not an absent delivered capability; account for all participants. Do not manufacture cleanup when no resource was allocated.
acceptance.historicalEvidenceRule: Golden Task references below preserve requirements and counterevidence. No old PASS is automatically admitted against this successor, a changed package, a different entry or a changed host composition.

duties.name: 目标、授权与用户纠正
duties.activationWhen: A goal, consequential authority boundary or user correction needs reconciliation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Progress on sufficient current agreement without requiring a complete up-front specification or host-operation vocabulary. Distinguish the desired outcome from a proposed means when the difference changes the route; explain consequential choices in outcome terms. Reconcile evolving needs, evidence and user corrections only where consequential; preserve human decisions and disclose changes to goals, authority or acceptance without transferring Agent mechanics to the user. Interpret a later agreement in the active-goal context: carry out the approved next step and remaining authorized work; standalone conversation does not authorize implementation. A substep, diagnostic report or agreement acknowledgment is not outcome completion. Respect user stop and genuine execution or decision boundaries.
duties.normalEntry: User request or correction through the active Agent and supported approval surfaces.
duties.failureOracle: Reject unauthorized effects, stale goals, repeated intake without decision value, and silent acceptance changes; retain corrections while preserving unaffected safe work.

duties.name: 环境感知与自身能力识别
duties.activationWhen: A relevant environment assumption is missing, stale, changed or conflicting.
duties.requiredOutcome: Distinguish declared, installed, exposed and effective capability from current permitted observations.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host state and task-time queries, with bounded fallback for unavailable fields.
duties.failureOracle: Unknown or conflicting state cannot be promoted to availability or success. An unavailable irrelevant field does not block an otherwise supported safe decision.

duties.name: 按需研究、学习与复用发现
duties.activationWhen: A material gap, uncertainty, domain shift or plausible net improvement in quality, risk or total burden can change the next safe decision, even when native can finish; not every request or phase.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reuse current capabilities and sound prior evidence. Resolve consequential feasibility or comparative-fit uncertainty with authoritative sources, maintained external candidates or bounded probes. Discover beyond installed inventory when warranted; compare required effects, evidence, fit, maintenance, license, permissions and full adoption/use/recovery/exit cost. Domain depth may require data, a tool, another model or professional review, not necessarily a plugin. Distinguish fact, inference and unknown; missing conditions do not prove impossibility. Convert gaps into prerequisites and authorized work. Stop research when further search is unlikely to change the safe choice, then execute or verify. Discovery grants no installation, account, data or cost authority.
duties.normalEntry: Reuse actually callable host search, recommendation and lifecycle interfaces, supported marketplaces and reliable external sources. A Skill naming a tool does not expose it; use supported fallback or disclose the exact gap. Do not duplicate a sufficient native discovery/selection chain.
duties.failureOracle: Reject native-sufficiency-only stopping, installed-only discovery when comparison matters, specialist labels or marketplace compatibility mistaken for quality, unsupported global-best or impossibility claims, endless research and premature custom construction. When research is unavailable, proceed only on adequately supported safe decisions; preserve necessary results and expose unresolved prerequisites.

duties.name: 关系判断、路线与形态选择
duties.activationWhen: Responsibilities need allocation, a route is insufficient, or material evidence warrants a better-fit comparison.
duties.requiredOutcome: Choose a feasible composition and execution/state topology covering bound functions, quality and relations. Compare evidence and full lifecycle burden; native is a starting or equal-fit preference, not a hard priority. Include needs-based main/subagent model and reasoning choices through sufficient native controls or justified composition. Reconcile ownership, permission and recovery when topology changes. Use direct queries or a justified representation; neither a maintained index nor a graph is itself a required result.
duties.normalEntry: Agent decision using current host capabilities and any admitted reference or runtime support.
duties.failureOracle: A cheap partial route cannot displace a sufficient one; a runtime cannot be excluded by name. Native capability cannot veto a better admitted candidate; an uninstalled listing cannot prove executable availability. Default inheritance, a requested model or an unverified switch cannot prove task-fit routing.

duties.name: 执行、配置与代码操作
duties.activationWhen: An authorized result requires an actual operation or missing capability implementation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Translate the authorized outcome into suitable native actions, interfaces or a sufficient composition, then verify the exact change while preserving unrelated state. Users need not identify buttons, commands, shell or code/conversation topology. Discoverability is not actionability or authority; select and operate only applicable supported controls, keep meaningful intervention/revocation available, and close attributable resources through the mapped lifecycle duties.
duties.normalEntry: Agent tools, supported host actions or a declared composed or authored executor.
duties.failureOracle: A plan, capability/button inventory, tool declaration or evaluator-only action cannot stand in for delivered execution. Reject unnecessary requests that the user choose internal commands or operate discoverable mechanics; an outcome request cannot silently authorize unrelated configuration, code topology or external writes.

duties.name: 源头变更与全局一致性
duties.activationWhen: A premise, bound commitment, rule or interface materially changes.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reconcile all affected design, execution and acceptance consumers without activating unrelated rules globally.
duties.normalEntry: Bound user correction or observed counterevidence followed by dependency-scoped review and change.
duties.failureOracle: Conflicting consumers or changed criteria cannot retain an obsolete success claim.

duties.name: 纠错、经验吸收与受控演进
duties.activationWhen: An error or changed premise affects current work; cross-task reuse or product-rule evolution activates separately when useful and authorized.
duties.requiredOutcome: Apply current corrections to affected decisions, actions and necessary task state without waiting for a learning pipeline or global memory. Persist cross-task lessons only when useful, permitted and scoped; verify changed behavior without weakening commitments.
duties.normalEntry: The active Agent and supported task state for immediate correction; separately authorized persistence or bounded experiments for reusable learning.
duties.failureOracle: Failed learning is reversible where promised; a local lesson cannot become an unconditional global rule.

duties.name: 故障恢复与回滚
duties.activationWhen: A failed or unsafe transition needs containment, compensation or restoration.
duties.requiredOutcome: A surviving authorized executor reaches independently checked safe post-state within the promised recovery boundary.
duties.normalEntry: Supported native recovery or a declared fallback executor with bounded ownership and effects.
duties.failureOracle: Preserve concurrent and foreign state; disclose uncovered or irreversible effects instead of claiming universal rollback.

duties.name: 上下文与任务连续性
duties.activationWhen: Observed carrier fitness or a bound task transition requires continuity work.
duties.requiredOutcome: Within bound authority, own continuity without repeated user reminders or manual carrier management. The successor independently reconciles the latest goal, authority, corrections, unresolved work and relevant upstream/downstream state against current sources. Deliver and confirm takeover with one active writer before releasing source allocations; read-only fact checks are not takeover. Preserve code topology and user task/history. Archiving any task requires explicit user authorization; handoff, completion and cleanup grant none.
duties.normalEntry: Supported current-host signals and task controls with a sufficient scoped transfer carrier. Declare who detects the need, executes the transition, preserves necessary state and survives a failed transition. Compose runtime support for missing duties; evaluator-triggered rescue does not establish ordinary-entry autonomy.
duties.failureOracle: Reject unauthorized archival even after successful takeover, source self-archive before delivery/acceptance, missed necessary transitions, stale or self-attested readiness, concurrent writers and release before verification. Destination failure or mid-transfer correction preserves the last safe carrier/state. Do not infer past non-archival from current unarchived state after user restoration, or success from missing tool summaries; inspect bounded original action records. Archive acknowledgement is not unload. Authorized archival must protect dependent/foreign tasks and account for actual cascade semantics. User recovery cannot close autonomous continuity.

duties.name: 资源管理与清理
duties.activationWhen: Task resources are allocated, constrained, changed or released.
duties.requiredOutcome: Use task-fit allocations and release attributable active resources and temporary exposure through supported authorized controls, with observed post-state. Separate stopping use, disabling, uninstalling and retirement. Preserve user-owned/shared resources; uncertain reuse favors a reversible inactive state where supported, with fit and trust revalidated after material drift.
duties.normalEntry: Native admission and lifecycle controls or an admitted resource-owning composition.
duties.failureOracle: Completion or command success does not prove cleanup or authorize removing user-owned tools. Protect shared and unknown resources; unavailable scoped controls are an explicit limit, not permission for global disablement. User tasks and history are not disposable residue; archival requires explicit user authorization.

duties.name: 安装、更新与卸载生命周期
duties.activationWhen: The user authorizes a lifecycle change to selected Accord components.
duties.requiredOutcome: One supported intent after necessary trust owns the selected components, handles failure and verifies active state and attributable residue.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host lifecycle controls, available before installation and after removal; necessary compensation needs an explicitly available surviving executor independent of the removed Skill.
duties.failureOracle: Changed package bytes need fresh lifecycle evidence; installation, cache presence and current-session activation remain separate. An absent package cannot supply its own unavailable compensation; evaluator rescue is not delivered lifecycle evidence.

duties.name: 原生接替、旁路与退役
duties.activationWhen: A better-fit same-duty successor can reduce intervention, or a reconciled need no longer justifies an allocation or asset.
duties.requiredOutcome: Preserve still-needed function and quality through verified successor transition, recovery and cleanup. For an unnecessary asset, reconcile need, callers and acceptance before authorized retirement. Consider ownership, reuse, expiry and upkeep; use a reversible inactive state when reuse is uncertain and supported.
duties.normalEntry: Current capability comparison and authorized host or component lifecycle controls.
duties.failureOracle: A version label, capability overlap, task completion or a guess of no future reuse cannot justify deletion. Do not retain misleading active historical guidance merely because it once applied; preserve immutable evidence and reopen dependent uncertainty on drift.

duties.name: 结果验证、独立证据与实际价值
duties.activationWhen: A result, functional availability, completion or value claim is proposed.
duties.requiredOutcome: Suitable observations support exactly the claim and its scope, with all required outcomes and applicable post-state accounted for. For claimed incremental benefit, compare suitable native-only and exact-package normal-entry paths under declared conditions; observe delivered outcomes, user intervention/correction/recovery burden and relevant cost. Installation or invocation alone is not value; do not add visible ceremony to simulate benefit.
duties.normalEntry: Task-specific result and post-state observation through suitable independent checks. Maintainer qualification and matched native/package comparison apply to product or incremental-value claims, not every ordinary task.
duties.failureOracle: Reject self-attested success, evaluator rescue presented as product function and safety-only or static-only proof of complete functionality.

changePolicy.rule: Treat change as normal. Re-sense decision-relevant facts from supported current sources, invalidate only dependent applicability, routes and claims, and revalidate the affected boundary. Missing signals justify just-in-time checks, not silent monitoring or a universal watcher. Topology is also context-selected: keep it when sufficient, change it for an evidenced fit, failure or benefit, and reconcile actors, state ownership, permissions, surviving recovery and acceptance. Conversation, execution, code and deployment topology are distinct; a change to one does not authorize changes to the others or new consequential effects.
changePolicy.versionRule: Installed, enabled, cached and actually loaded versions are distinct observations. Evidence remains true of its original composition; changed assumptions require new applicability evidence before current reuse.
changePolicy.replacementRule: A new host capability may replace an exact duty after sufficient same-duty effect and lifecycle evidence. An unavailable mechanism restores uncertainty, not product retirement or a reduced requirement.
changePolicy.sourceRevisionRule: A legitimate change to source semantics or acceptance invalidates dependent claims. Keep the predecessor and failed trials immutable; never rewrite an old result to make a new definition pass.

nextBoundary.work: The conditional current-development evidence evaluator is implemented locally; bind concrete claim scopes, real case oracles and trusted independent read-only source verification before collecting qualifying evidence. Commit evaluated implementation and acceptance A, collect observations E, and review final candidate B under unchanged affected dependencies. Keep diagnostic observations and synthetic fixtures separate from acceptance. Continue ordinary-entry whole-chain, failure, lifecycle and value work; package sufficiency and release gates remain open. Additional vendors remain deferred.
nextBoundary.requires: The user authorized controlled existing-host work and publication of the accepted 3.2 candidate. Use task-owned bounded test resources, not changes to the personal host. Bind any new account, trust/data or material cost before effects; evidence and exact-candidate checks still precede the conditional publication.
